expected_rate: every 2 minutes while the market is closed and no Day lot is open (the around-the-clock schedule); overnight exit orders only when a Day lot is held past 8 PM ET (rare)
window_reason: the idle proof fires dozens of times every night; two sessions without it means the schedule or the early exit is broken
reversal: no idle-tick line overnight (the cron or early exit is broken), a Day lot still open after the regular open without the deadline flatten, or an overnight exit priced from a quote older than 5 minutes
